primary_endpoint: Relative change in liver fat percentage by MRI-PDFF from baseline to Week 12.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 12, liver fat changed by −1.14% with placebo, −1.03% with PXL770 250 mg QD (p=0.9883), −14.28% with 250 mg BID (p=0.0842), and −14.68% with 500 mg QD (p=0.0763); no dose was significant on the primary analysis.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events occurred in 0/31 placebo, 0/30 PXL770 250 mg QD, 2/30 PXL770 250 mg BID, and 1/29 PXL770 500 mg QD participants; no deaths.
